direction.TARGET_BAND: Closer to the target is better

financials.forbidden: You do not have access to this project's financials.

live.title: Current financial position
live.unpublished: Includes figures AHDA has not yet published

current.title: Financial update in progress
current.none: No financial update is in progress
current.notActive: Financial figures are reported once the project is active.
current.startHint: Report the actual expenditure and forecast for the next period. Every figure starts as "No data" until you enter it.

next.DRAFT: The Project Manager completes the figures and submits them.
next.SUBMITTED: Waiting for AHDA to start the review.
next.RETURNED: Returned: the next revision is prepared.

sources.title: Where the figures come from
sources.notConnected: No integrated source is connected yet: an integrated figure stays "No data" until one is.

update.title: Update financial progress
update.manual: Amounts are in SAR. What you enter is recorded as a manual entry, with you as the person who entered it.
update.valueStatus: What is known for this period

status.MISSING: No data: the figures are not available
status.STALE: Stale: the latest figures are out of date

update.noFigure: No figure is sent. The period will show "{state}", never 0.
update.amountHint: Digits only, up to two decimal places, for example 1250000.00.
update.forecastHint: Optional. Leave it empty if there is no forecast; it will show "No forecast given", never 0.
update.actualIntegrated: Actual expenditure comes from an integrated source and cannot be entered by hand. Record why there is no figure instead.
update.forecastIntegrated: The forecast comes from an integrated source and cannot be entered by hand.
update.asOfHint: The day the figures are true as of. It cannot be after today.
update.sourceReferenceHint: Optional. The document or system the figures come from, up to {max} characters.

review.title: Review financial update
review.publishConsequence: Publishing writes the period's official record, rated under the thresholds in force. It cannot be changed afterwards.
review.returnConsequence: The Project Manager sees this reason and prepares the next revision.
review.startConsequence: Starting the review lets you publish or return the figures.

history.title: Financial progress
history.updatesCaption: Every revision of every period, newest first
history.noUpdates: No financial update has been recorded yet
history.budgetsCaption: Every version of the approved budget, newest first

kpis.title: Key performance indicators
kpis.caption: The project's KPIs and where each stands this period
kpis.forbidden: You do not have access to KPIs.
kpis.empty: No KPIs are assigned to this project
kpis.emptyBody: AHDA assigns KPIs and approves their targets. Once one is assigned, its values are recorded here.

kpiValue.title: Update KPI value: {kpi}
kpiValue.pinsTarget: This value will be rated against target version {version} ({target} {unit}), the one in force now, for good. A later target never changes it.
kpiValue.pinnedTarget: This value is rated against target version {version} ({target} {unit}), the one in force when it was recorded.
kpiValue.noTarget: This KPI has no approved target, so no value can be recorded yet.
kpiValue.periodHint: The period this value covers. The current month is suggested.
kpiValue.valueStatus: What is known for this period

status.MISSING: No data: the value is not available
status.STALE: Stale: the latest value is out of date

kpiValue.noValue: No value is sent. The period will show "{state}", never 0, and is not rated.

publish.title: Publish KPI value: {kpi}
publish.consequence: Publishing makes this the official value for the period. It cannot be changed afterwards.

trend.heading: {kpi}: history and trend
trend.explanation: Each value is drawn beside the target it was rated against when it was recorded. When a new target is approved, the line steps to it from the next value on; earlier values keep their own target.
trend.title: Trend of {kpi} ({unit})

legend.target: Target, as pinned when each value was recorded

trend.notFound: This KPI is not assigned to this project.
trend.valuesCaption: Every value of this KPI, latest period first, with the target it is rated against
trend.targetsCaption: Every version of this KPI's target, newest first

register.title: KPI register
register.description: Every KPI of the projects you can see, with where each stands this period.
register.caption: KPIs of every project you can see
register.emptyBody: KPIs appear here once AHDA assigns them to a project you can see.
register.filteredEmptyBody: Choose "All KPIs" to see every KPI again.

aggregate.title: Across projects
aggregate.explanation: The latest published value of each KPI, combined only where every project measures it in the same unit.
aggregate.noMean: No average: no project has a published measured value.
aggregate.unitsDiffer: Not combined: the projects measure this KPI in different units.
aggregate.ragCounts: Green {green} · Amber {amber} · Red {red} · Not rated {unknown} · Not applicable {notApplicable}
aggregate.unavailable: The combined figures are not available to you.

done.updateSubmitted: The financial update was submitted for review.
done.returned: The financial update was returned for correction.
done.stale: Someone changed this record meanwhile. It has been read again; nothing was changed.

problems.projectNotEligible: Figures are reported only for an active project.
problems.fieldIntegrated: This figure comes from an integrated source and cannot be entered by hand.
problems.nothingToReport: There is no period to report yet: periods begin once progress reporting starts.
problems.updateExists: A financial update is already in progress. It has been read again.
problems.notEditable: This record can no longer be changed.
problems.valueStatusInvalid: A figure is given only when it is known; otherwise say why there is none.
problems.asOfDateInvalid: The as-of date cannot be after today.
problems.assignmentNotActive: This KPI is suspended or retired.
problems.targetNotApproved: This KPI has no approved target, so no value can be recorded yet.
problems.measurementExists: A value is already recorded for this period.
problems.periodInvalid: The period ends before it starts.
problems.configurationMissing: The financial-status thresholds are not configured, so nothing can be published. Ask AHDA to publish them.
problems.invalidTransition: This record has moved on. It has been read again.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do this.

fieldErrors.asOfInFuture: The as-of date cannot be after today.
fieldErrors.periodEndBeforeStart: The period cannot end before it starts.
fieldErrors.amountMalformed: Enter an amount in SAR: digits only, up to two decimal places.
fieldErrors.kpiValueOutOfRange: Enter a number with up to four decimal places.
